text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of the biggest impacts is automation, where AI now handles routine tasks like data entry, scheduling, and basic customer service. This shift allows employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. Beyond automation, AI-powered productivity tools help teams analyze large amounts of data quickly, draft documents, and even manage projects. However, the goal is not to replace humans entirely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming key, with people providing judgment and empathy while AI offers speed and accuracy. This means job roles are changing; workers must learn new skills, such as managing AI systems and interpreting their outputs, to stay relevant in this evolving environment.
